why: Language phenomena the nexus ALREADY handles, where, how it is read, and whether it is reachable through a door (by kind on the pharos). Written 2026-11-27 after janus's edit-intent re-built a cruder negation and question guard beside khora's solved ones. A new organ that handles one of these phenomena must read the entry below, reuse it or say why not. Every `where` was checked by grep on the date; `by_kind` is whether a janus session reading the pharos can see the result without importing the other repo.

entries.phenomenon: roles: who did what to whom (the nine karakas, and a named non-karaka relation for every other row)
entries.rule: a declared, language-independent map from UD relations to Paninian labels; marker tables per language (eng, zh) decide adposition-marked roles; declared, not measured
entries.note: woven as text-roles (CON·Figure) since khora PR #117; janus edit-intent takes a request's theme from the KARMAN, not the UD obj arc

entries.rule: UD features Polarity=Neg or PronType=Neg on a node, never a word list; placed on the predication it attaches to
entries.note: woven by khora as text-polarity (SIG·Figure) since khora PR #117 (draft, base chat-engine); janus edit-weave reads it by kind and falls back to its own check of the same two features when the entry is absent

entries.phenomenon: question form (wh | polar | deliberative | statement) and what a wh-word asks for
entries.rule: UD PronType=Int, aux-first, a closed class of interrogatives and modals WITH a named giver (CGEL)
entries.note: English only; woven by khora as text-question (SIG·Figure) since khora PR #117; a language with no adapter is the typed gap no_question_grammar

entries.phenomenon: coordination, relative clauses, controlled clauses, passives, copulas, years as ground
entries.rule: rows -> claims with polarity; typed gaps conj_not_expanded, unbound_pronoun, no_subject
entries.note: pure function over reader rows; not an imperative reader

entries.rule: apoha over a frozen embedding against a shuffled null; abstains below the null
entries.note: relevant to 'make it better': a word's direction is MEASURED there, not declared; NOT woven by kind (recordPolarity writes its own entries on request)

entries.phenomenon: speech frames: who holds quoted or reported words
entries.rule: quote tables per codec + speech-verb act prior

entries.note: NOT woven: on the entry only (entry.clauses)

entries.phenomenon: speaker and addressee bindings (I / you inside a quotation)

entries.rule: khora cast + presence binding; a mention resolves to an admitted referent or abstains
entries.note: woven only when the caller asks (referents: true with the canonical door); janus edit-weave does NOT read it yet, so 'delete it' stays referent_unresolved unless the caller states the salient referent
